protocol.selection: For each score/policy, minimize validation FP preserving every originally detected real pair. If infeasible, record no candidate; best-F1 threshold is diagnostic only.
protocol.caveat: Historical benchmark already examined. Static snapshots cannot measure warning delay or real stream persistence. No live threshold changes.
protocol.threshold_zero: Still requires at least one predicted conflicting combination; no combination is not treated as a zero-threshold alert.
protocol.probability: Top-five weights normalized per aircraft; products assume independent choices. Not calibrated conflict probabilities.
protocol.own_design: All-pairs shadow state, threshold policies and persistence are our own experimental design.
